name: Saltfire Solstice — Vertical Farm Harvest Rave
creator: Shelf Agricultural Cooperative Network (SACN), originated by Blessing Oduya-Korhonen
description: A three-day annual event held in the grow-towers of the Shelf's vertical farm districts, Saltfire Solstice combines communal harvest celebration with bass-heavy rave culture, bioluminescent crop installations, and open communal cooking. What began in 2196 as an informal Tier 1 neighborhood feast in the Pilsen Stack's hydroponic corridors has grown into a sprawling multi-block festival drawing Tier 2 workers and even curious Tier 3 visitors. The event is powered entirely by surplus biogas from the farms themselves, and attendance is by community token — no Quanta required.
medium: physical / live event / ambient neural feed (unlicensed)
cultural_impact: Saltfire is one of the few recurring Shelf events that is entirely self-funded and community-governed, making it a symbol of Tier 1 economic autonomy and a model studied — and feared — by corponation urban planners.
controversy: HelixCorp has twice attempted to license and rebrand Saltfire as a managed 'heritage event,' both times met with organized refusal and, in 2214, a brief coordinated grow-tower lockout that shut down corporate inspectors for eleven days.
story_hooks: A corporate talent scout attends Saltfire undercover to recruit a legendary underground DJ, but becomes entangled in a SACN dispute over a contaminated grow-tower that someone powerful wants buried.
A Tier 3 journalist covering Saltfire for the first time witnesses a public community tribunal — a Shelf governance tradition — adjudicating a serious accusation against a festival elder.

The biogas grid powering the 2221 Saltfire is sabotaged hours before the main harvest ceremony, and the only people who knew the infrastructure layout were the corponation engineers turned away three years ago.
